Attack ONE named target from wave 1 or the frozen C1 CALIBRATION claim (tied lowest axis 8): contract frozen before dispatch, staged instruments, receipt-time instrument-sha/measurement-interval gate, 0/6 -> 6/6. Re-run the staged gate in a private /tmp sandbox; re-open each committed receipt; try to refute each claim element. The 18 round-18 guard survivors remain OPEN; do not claim them closed. Numeric calibration stays 8; no promotion/expansion.

Lane /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tameshi-shokunin. Contract commit 6fd220bce3705498d1d1054e99e3cae73c203751; stage/receipt-window.py sha256 f03ae7e91607750e2690f7819c486a3d9db03ee13f0b8cf51958462834dcf7cc; stage/measure.py f34dc233eee33f4fea9a82c391bfb57ebfef8983f5c7146b4d2dc0b6b3be4e2d; baseline c144dcd807166dfc275c1ac2936fd2fa4b678bda; wave-1 reports under .ufo/waves/round-20/w1/. # Contract
All lane paths absolute. Read-only seats return findings; the only file you may write is your unique Report trailer at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tameshi-shokunin/<that relative path>. Never edit production, tools/, corpus/, ledgers, fleet, siblings, Git/JJ refs/index/state. No git add/commit/push, no jj mutation. No agent://all. Leaf seats only.
